datamart_v2.v_manager_flash.ddl: CREATE VIEW `3000550035.datamart_v2`.v_manager_flash UUID 'e7f669ed-acb8-4318-83da-486a3e1eb5c6' (`id` Nullable(String), `organization_id` Nullable(String), `resort` Nullable(String), `property_id` Nullable(String), `room_class` Nullable(String), `type_of_room` Nullable(String), `total_rooms_in_hotel` Nullable(Int64), `business_date` Date, `out_of_order_rooms` UInt64, `out_of_service_rooms` UInt64, `total_rooms_in_hotel_minus_ooo_rooms` Int64, `canceled_reservations_for_today` UInt64, `reservations_cancellations_made_today` UInt64, `reservations_made_today` UInt64, `payment` Decimal(38, 2), `arrival_rooms_for_tomorrow` UInt64, `arrival_persons_for_tomorrow` Int64, `rooms_occupied` UInt64, `stay_room_converted` Int64, `available_rooms` Int64, `available_rooms_minus_ooo_rooms` Int64, `complimentary_rooms` UInt64, `house_use_rooms` UInt64, `complimentary` UInt64, `rooms_occupied_minus_complimentary` Int64, `rooms_occupied_minus_house_use` Int64, `rooms_occupied_minus_complimentary_and_house_use` Int64, `day_use_rooms` UInt64, `adults` Int64, `children` Int64, `total_persons` Int64, `stay_adults` UInt64, `stay_children` UInt64, `stay_persons` UInt64, `individual_persons` Int64, `block_persons` Int64, `vip_persons` UInt64, `individual_rooms` UInt64, `block_rooms` UInt64, `company_rooms` UInt64, `travel_agent_rooms` UInt64, `arrival_rooms` UInt64, `arrival_persons` Int64, `actual_arrival_rooms` UInt64, `actual_arrival_persons` UInt64, `departure_rooms` UInt64, `departure_persons` UInt64, `individual_departure_rooms` UInt64, `individual_departure_persons` UInt64, `no_show_rooms` UInt64, `no_show_persons` Int64, `room_revenue` Decimal(38, 2), `fnb_revenue` Decimal(38, 2), `other_revenue` Decimal(38, 2), `total_revenue` Decimal(38, 2), `block_revenue` Decimal(38, 2), `block_room_revenue` Decimal(38, 2), `individual_revenue` Decimal(38, 2), `individual_room_revenue` Decimal(38, 2), `departure_rooms_for_tomorrow` UInt64, `departure_persons_for_tomorrow` Int64, `processing_time` DateTime('Asia/Bangkok')) AS WITH date_range AS (SELECT DATE(arrayJoin(arrayMap(x -> (today() - x), range(toUInt64(dateDiff('day', getPreviousYear(today()), today())) + 1)))) AS business_date), rc AS (SELECT id, code, hotelId AS hotel_id, isDeleted AS is_deleted, status FROM `3000550035.vp_prod_pms_property`.pro_room_class WHERE 1 AND (isDeleted = 0) AND (status = 1)), valid_properties AS (SELECT id, organizationId AS organization_id, code FROM `3000550035.vp_prod_pms_property`.pro_hotel WHERE excludeProperty(id) = 1), valid_room_types AS (SELECT rt.id AS id, rt.hotelId AS hotel_id, rt.code AS code, rt.typeOfRoom AS type_of_room, rt.roomClassId AS room_class_id, rt.numberOfTotalRoom AS number_of_total_room, rt.isPseudo AS is_pseudo, h.code AS resort_code, h.organization_id AS organization_id FROM `3000550035.vp_prod_pms_property`.pro_room_type AS rt INNER JOIN valid_properties AS h ON rt.hotelId = h.id WHERE (rt.isDeleted = 0) AND (rt.status = 1)), room AS (SELECT dr.business_date AS business_date, vrt.type_of_room AS type_of_room, rc.code AS room_class, vrt.resort_code AS resort, vrt.hotel_id AS property_id, vrt.organization_id AS organization_id, sum(vrt.number_of_total_room) AS total_room FROM date_range AS dr CROSS JOIN valid_room_types AS vrt INNER JOIN rc ON vrt.room_class_id = rc.id GROUP BY dr.business_date, vrt.type_of_room, rc.code, vrt.resort_code, vrt.hotel_id, vrt.organization_id), resv AS (SELECT rt.organization_id AS organization_id, rs.resv_name_id AS resv_name_id, rs.resort AS resort, rs.business_date AS business_date, rt.type_of_room AS type_of_room, rs.room_class AS room_class, sum(multiIf(complimentary_yn = 'Y', 1, 0)) AS complimentary, sum(stay_rooms) AS rooms_occupied, sum(rs.stay_rooms * rcv.conversion_rate) AS stay_room_converted, sum(multiIf((complimentary_yn = 'Y') AND (stay_rooms = 1), 1, 0)) AS complimentary_rooms, sum(multiIf((house_use_yn = 'Y') AND (stay_rooms = 1), 1, 0)) AS house_use_rooms, sum(day_use_rooms) AS day_use_rooms, sum(multiIf(resv_status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Noshow'), adults, 0)) AS adults_original, sum(multiIf(resv_status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Noshow'), children, 0)) AS children_original, sum(multiIf(resv_status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Noshow'), adults + children, 0)) AS total_persons, sum(stay_adults) AS stay_adults, sum(stay_children) AS stay_children, sum(stay_persons) AS stay_persons, sum(multiIf(ifNull(allotment_code, '') = '', (adults + children) * stay_rooms, 0)) AS individual_persons, sum(multiIf(ifNull(allotment_code, '') != '', (adults + children) * stay_rooms, 0)) AS block_persons, sum(multiIf((ifNull(vip_status, '') != '') AND (resv_status = 'Inhouse') AND (rt.is_pseudo = 0), 1, 0)) AS vip_persons, sum(multiIf((ifNull(allotment_code, '') = '') AND (primary_yn = 'Y'), stay_rooms, 0)) AS individual_rooms, sum(multiIf((ifNull(allotment_code, '') != '') AND (primary_yn = 'Y'), stay_rooms, 0)) AS block_rooms, sum(multiIf(ifNull(company_id, '') != '', stay_rooms, 0)) AS company_rooms, sum(multiIf(ifNull(agent_id, '') != '', stay_rooms, 0)) AS travel_agent_rooms, sum(multiIf((toDate(trunc_begin_date) = business_date) AND (resv_status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Noshow')) AND (rt.is_pseudo = 0), 1, 0)) AS arrival_rooms, sum(multiIf((toDate(trunc_begin_date) = business_date) AND (resv_status NOT IN ('Canceled', 'Noshow')) AND (rt.is_pseudo = 0), adults + children, 0)) AS arrival_persons, sum(multiIf(rt.is_pseudo = 0, arr_rooms, 0)) AS actual_arrival_rooms, sum(multiIf(rt.is_pseudo = 0, arr_persons, 0)) AS actual_arrival_persons, sum(multiIf(rt.is_pseudo = 0, dep_rooms, 0)) AS departure_rooms, sum(multiIf(rt.is_pseudo = 0, dep_persons, 0)) AS departure_persons, sum(multiIf((ifNull(allotment_code, '') = '') AND (rt.is_pseudo = 0), dep_rooms, 0)) AS individual_departure_rooms, sum(multiIf((ifNull(allotment_code, '') = '') AND (rt.is_pseudo = 0), dep_persons, 0)) AS individual_departure_persons, sum(multiIf(rt.is_pseudo = 0, no_show_rooms, 0)) AS no_show_rooms, sum(multiIf(rt.is_pseudo = 0, no_show_persons, 0)) AS no_show_persons, sum(multiIf((stay_rooms > 0) AND (rt.is_pseudo = 0), toInt64(room_revenue / stay_rooms), rt.is_pseudo = 1, room_revenue, 0)) AS adr, sum(multiIf((complimentary_yn = 'N') AND (stay_rooms > 0) AND (rt.is_pseudo = 0), toInt64(room_revenue / stay_rooms), (complimentary_yn = 'N') AND (rt.is_pseudo = 1), room_revenue, 0)) AS adr_minus_comp, sum(multiIf((complimentary_yn = 'N') AND (house_use_yn = 'N') AND (stay_rooms > 0) AND (rt.is_pseudo = 0), toInt64(room_revenue / stay_rooms), (complimentary_yn = 'N') AND (house_use_yn = 'N') AND (rt.is_pseudo = 1), room_revenue, 0)) AS adr_minus_comp_and_house, sum(multiIf((house_use_yn = 'N') AND (stay_rooms > 0) AND (rt.is_pseudo = 0), toInt64(room_revenue / stay_rooms), (house_use_yn = 'N') AND (rt.is_pseudo = 1), room_revenue, 0)) AS adr_minus_house, sum(multiIf((adults > 0) AND (rt.is_pseudo = 0), room_revenue / (adults + children), rt.is_pseudo = 1, room_revenue, 0)) AS average_person_rate, sum(multiIf((ifNull(allotment_code, '') != '') AND (stay_rooms > 0), total_revenue, 0)) AS average_revenue_per_block_rooms, sum(multiIf((ifNull(allotment_code, '') != '') AND (stay_rooms > 0), room_revenue, 0)) AS average_room_revenue_per_block_rooms, sum(multiIf((adults > 0) AND (rt.is_pseudo = 0), total_revenue / (adults + children), rt.is_pseudo = 1, total_revenue, 0)) AS total_revenue_per_person, sum(multiIf((toDate(trunc_end_date) = (business_date + 1)) AND (rt.is_pseudo = 0), 1, 0)) AS departure_rooms_for_tomorrow, sum(multiIf((toDate(trunc_end_date) = (business_date + 1)) AND (rt.is_pseudo = 0), adults + children, 0)) AS departure_persons_for_tomorrow FROM `3000550035.datamart`.cirrus_reservation_stat AS rs INNER JOIN valid_room_types AS rt ON rs.room_type = rt.code LEFT JOIN `3000550035.datamart_v2`.room_conversion AS rcv ON (rs.resort = rcv.resort) AND (rs.room_type = rcv.room_type) AND (rs.room_class = rcv.room_class) AND (rt.hotel_id = rcv.property_id) WHERE (rs.business_date >= getPreviousYear(today())) AND (rs.business_date <= today()) GROUP BY rt.organization_id, rs.resv_name_id, rs.resort, rs.business_date, rt.type_of_room, rs.room_class), rrc AS (SELECT rc.code AS room_class, rt.resort_code AS resort, rt.hotel_id AS property_id, rt.type_of_room AS type_of_room, r.BookingDate AS booking_date, binToString(r.ReservationId) AS reservation_id, r.Status AS status, r.ArrivalDate AS arrival_date, r.numberOfChild AS number_of_child, r.numberOfAdult AS number_of_adult FROM `3000550035.vp_prod_ops_front_office`.Reservation AS r INNER JOIN valid_room_types AS rt ON (r.RoomTypeCode = rt.code) AND (rt.is_pseudo = 0) INNER JOIN rc ON rt.room_class_id = rc.id), rrc1 AS (SELECT room_class AS room_class, resort AS resort, property_id AS property_id, type_of_room AS type_of_room, DATE(booking_date + toIntervalHour(7)) - 1 AS business_date, count(1) AS reservations_made_today FROM rrc WHERE (DATE(booking_date + toIntervalHour(7)) >= getPreviousYear(today())) AND (DATE(booking_date + toIntervalHour(7)) <= today()) GROUP BY room_class, resort, property_id, type_of_room, business_date), rrc2 AS (SELECT room_class AS room_class, resort AS resort, property_id AS property_id, type_of_room AS type_of_room, DATE(c.CancelledAt + toIntervalHour(7)) AS business_date, count(1) AS reservations_cancellations_made_today FROM rrc INNER JOIN `3000550035.vp_prod_ops_front_office`.Cancellation AS c ON reservation_id = c.ReservationId WHERE (DATE(c.CancelledAt + toIntervalHour(7)) >= getPreviousYear(today())) AND (DATE(c.CancelledAt + toIntervalHour(7)) <= today()) GROUP BY room_class, resort, property_id, type_of_room, business_date), rrc3 AS (SELECT room_class AS room_class, resort AS resort, property_id AS property_id, type_of_room AS type_of_room, DATE(arrival_date) - 1 AS business_date, count(1) AS arrival_rooms_for_tomorrow, sum(coalesce(number_of_adult, 0) + coalesce(number_of_child, 0)) AS arrival_persons_for_tomorrow FROM rrc WHERE (status != 'Canceled') AND ((arrival_date >= getPreviousYear(today())) AND (arrival_date <= (today() + 1))) GROUP BY room_class, resort, property_id, type_of_room, business_date), rp AS (SELECT h.code AS resort, r.BusinessDate AS business_date, rc.code AS room_class, sum(-1 * r.Amount) AS payment FROM `3000550035.vp_prod_ops_transaction_account`.PostTransaction AS r INNER JOIN valid_properties AS h ON r.PropertyId = h.id INNER JOIN rc ON (h.id = rc.hotel_id) AND (rc.code LIKE 'PSE%') WHERE ((r.BusinessDate >= getPreviousYear(today())) AND (r.BusinessDate <= today())) AND (r.CategoryCode = 'PAYMENT') AND (r.TransactionAccountCode != '9980') AND ((r.State = 1) OR ((r.State = 5) AND (r.TransactionReferenceType = 'ORIGINAL_DP'))) GROUP BY h.code, r.BusinessDate, rc.code), cc AS (SELECT rs.resort AS resort, rs.business_date AS business_date, rs.room_class AS room_class, sum(rs.canceled_rooms) AS canceled_reservations_for_today FROM `3000550035.datamart`.cirrus_reservation_stat AS rs WHERE ((rs.business_date >= getPreviousYear(today())) AND (rs.business_date <= today())) AND (rs.resv_status = 'Canceled') AND (rs.psuedo_room_yn = 'N') GROUP BY rs.resort, rs.business_date, rs.room_class), revenue AS (SELECT resv_name_id, resort, business_date, room_class, sum(room_revenue) AS room_revenue_original, sum(food_revenue) AS fnb_revenue, sum(other_revenue) AS other_revenue, sum(total_revenue) AS total_revenue_original, sum(multiIf(coalesce(allotment_code, '') != '', total_revenue, 0)) AS block_revenue, sum(multiIf(coalesce(allotment_code, '') != '', room_revenue, 0)) AS block_room_revenue, sum(multiIf(coalesce(allotment_code, '') = '', total_revenue, 0)) AS individual_revenue, sum(multiIf(coalesce(allotment_code, '') = '', room_revenue, 0)) AS individual_room_revenue, sum(room_revenue) AS adr, sum(multiIf(complimentary_yn = 'N', room_revenue, 0)) AS adr_minus_comp, sum(multiIf((complimentary_yn = 'N') AND (house_use_yn = 'N'), room_revenue, 0)) AS adr_minus_comp_and_house, sum(multiIf(house_use_yn = 'N', room_revenue, 0)) AS adr_minus_house FROM `3000550035.datamart`.cirrus_reservation_stat AS rs WHERE (business_date >= getPreviousYear(today())) AND (business_date <= today()) GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4), ooo AS (SELECT rt.resort_code AS resort, rc.code AS room_class, dr.business_date AS business_date, count(1) AS ooo FROM date_range AS dr CROSS JOIN valid_room_types AS rt INNER JOIN rc ON rt.room_class_id = rc.id INNER JOIN `3000550035.vp_prod_pms_property`.pro_room AS r ON r.roomTypeId = rt.id INNER JOIN `3000550035.vp_prod_pms_room_management`.pro_room_blocking_history AS oo ON (oo.roomId = r.id) AND (oo.isDeleted = 0) AND (oo.currentStatus = 'OUT_OF_ORDER') AND (DATE(oo.blockBeginAt) <= dr.business_date) AND (DATE(oo.actualBlockEndAt) > dr.business_date) WHERE rt.is_pseudo = 0 GROUP BY resort, room_class, business_date), oos AS (SELECT rt.resort_code AS resort, rc.code AS room_class, dr.business_date AS business_date, count(1) AS oos FROM date_range AS dr CROSS JOIN valid_room_types AS rt INNER JOIN rc ON rt.room_class_id = rc.id INNER JOIN `3000550035.vp_prod_pms_property`.pro_room AS r ON r.roomTypeId = rt.id INNER JOIN `3000550035.vp_prod_pms_room_management`.pro_room_blocking_history AS oo ON (oo.roomId = r.id) AND (oo.isDeleted = 0) AND (oo.currentStatus = 'OUT_OF_SERVICE') AND (DATE(oo.blockBeginAt) <= dr.business_date) AND (DATE(oo.actualBlockEndAt) > dr.business_date) WHERE rt.is_pseudo = 0 GROUP BY resort, room_class, business_date) SELECT concat(room.property_id, room.business_date, room.room_class, coalesce(room.type_of_room, '')) AS id, room.organization_id AS organization_id, room.resort AS resort, room.property_id AS property_id, room.room_class AS room_class, room.type_of_room AS type_of_room, room.total_room AS total_rooms_in_hotel, room.business_date AS business_date, ifNull(ooo.ooo, 0) AS out_of_order_rooms, ifNull(oos.oos, 0) AS out_of_service_rooms, ifNull(room.total_room, 0) - ifNull(ooo.ooo, 0) AS total_rooms_in_hotel_minus_ooo_rooms, ifNull(cc.canceled_reservations_for_today, 0) AS canceled_reservations_for_today, ifNull(rrc2.reservations_cancellations_made_today, 0) AS reservations_cancellations_made_today, ifNull(rrc1.reservations_made_today, 0) AS reservations_made_today, ifNull(rp.payment, 0) AS payment, ifNull(rrc3.arrival_rooms_for_tomorrow, 0) AS arrival_rooms_for_tomorrow, ifNull(rrc3.arrival_persons_for_tomorrow, 0) AS arrival_persons_for_tomorrow, ifNull(sum(resv.rooms_occupied), 0) AS rooms_occupied, ifNull(sum(resv.stay_room_converted), 0) AS stay_room_converted, ifNull(room.total_room, 0) - ifNull(sum(resv.rooms_occupied), 0) AS available_rooms, (ifNull(room.total_room, 0) - ifNull(ooo.ooo, 0)) - ifNull(sum(resv.rooms_occupied), 0) AS available_rooms_minus_ooo_rooms, ifNull(sum(resv.complimentary_rooms), 0) AS complimentary_rooms, ifNull(sum(resv.house_use_rooms), 0) AS house_use_rooms, ifNull(sum(resv.complimentary), 0) AS complimentary, ifNull(sum(resv.rooms_occupied), 0) - ifNull(sum(resv.complimentary_rooms), 0) AS rooms_occupied_minus_complimentary, ifNull(sum(resv.rooms_occupied), 0) - ifNull(sum(resv.house_use_rooms), 0) AS rooms_occupied_minus_house_use, (ifNull(sum(resv.rooms_occupied), 0) - ifNull(sum(resv.complimentary_rooms), 0)) - ifNull(sum(resv.house_use_rooms), 0) AS rooms_occupied_minus_complimentary_and_house_use, ifNull(sum(resv.day_use_rooms), 0) AS day_use_rooms, ifNull(sumIf(resv.adults_original, resv.arrival_rooms > 0), 0) AS adults, ifNull(sumIf(resv.children_original, resv.arrival_rooms > 0), 0) AS children, ifNull(sumIf(resv.total_persons, resv.arrival_rooms > 0), 0) AS total_persons, ifNull(sum(resv.stay_adults), 0) AS stay_adults, ifNull(sum(resv.stay_children), 0) AS stay_children, ifNull(sum(resv.stay_persons), 0) AS stay_persons, ifNull(sum(resv.individual_persons), 0) AS individual_persons, ifNull(sum(resv.block_persons), 0) AS block_persons, ifNull(sum(resv.vip_persons), 0) AS vip_persons, ifNull(sum(resv.individual_rooms), 0) AS individual_rooms, ifNull(sum(resv.block_rooms), 0) AS block_rooms, ifNull(sum(resv.company_rooms), 0) AS company_rooms, ifNull(sum(resv.travel_agent_rooms), 0) AS travel_agent_rooms, ifNull(sum(resv.arrival_rooms), 0) AS arrival_rooms, ifNull(sum(resv.arrival_persons), 0) AS arrival_persons, ifNull(sum(resv.actual_arrival_rooms), 0) AS actual_arrival_rooms, ifNull(sum(resv.actual_arrival_persons), 0) AS actual_arrival_persons, ifNull(sum(resv.departure_rooms), 0) AS departure_rooms, ifNull(sum(resv.departure_persons), 0) AS departure_persons, ifNull(sum(resv.individual_departure_rooms), 0) AS individual_departure_rooms, ifNull(sum(resv.individual_departure_persons), 0) AS individual_departure_persons, ifNull(sum(resv.no_show_rooms), 0) AS no_show_rooms, ifNull(sum(resv.no_show_persons), 0) AS no_show_persons, ifNull(sum(revenue.room_revenue_original), 0) AS room_revenue, ifNull(sum(revenue.fnb_revenue), 0) AS fnb_revenue, ifNull(sum(revenue.other_revenue), 0) AS other_revenue, ifNull(sum(revenue.total_revenue_original), 0) AS total_revenue, ifNull(sum(revenue.block_revenue), 0) AS block_revenue, ifNull(sum(revenue.block_room_revenue), 0) AS block_room_revenue, ifNull(sum(revenue.individual_revenue), 0) AS individual_revenue, ifNull(sum(revenue.individual_room_revenue), 0) AS individual_room_revenue, ifNull(sum(resv.departure_rooms_for_tomorrow), 0) AS departure_rooms_for_tomorrow, ifNull(sum(resv.departure_persons_for_tomorrow), 0) AS departure_persons_for_tomorrow, now('Asia/Bangkok') AS processing_time FROM room LEFT JOIN resv ON (room.resort = resv.resort) AND (room.room_class = resv.room_class) AND (room.type_of_room = resv.type_of_room) AND (room.business_date = resv.business_date) LEFT JOIN revenue ON (resv.resv_name_id = revenue.resv_name_id) AND (resv.resort = revenue.resort) AND (resv.room_class = revenue.room_class) AND (resv.business_date = revenue.business_date) LEFT JOIN ooo ON (room.resort = ooo.resort) AND (room.room_class = ooo.room_class) AND (room.business_date = ooo.business_date) LEFT JOIN oos ON (room.resort = oos.resort) AND (room.room_class = oos.room_class) AND (room.business_date = oos.business_date) LEFT JOIN cc ON (room.resort = cc.resort) AND (room.room_class = cc.room_class) AND (room.business_date = cc.business_date) LEFT JOIN rrc1 ON (room.resort = rrc1.resort) AND (room.room_class = rrc1.room_class) AND (room.type_of_room = rrc1.type_of_room) AND (room.business_date = rrc1.business_date) LEFT JOIN rrc2 ON (room.resort = rrc2.resort) AND (room.room_class = rrc2.room_class) AND (room.type_of_room = rrc2.type_of_room) AND (room.business_date = rrc2.business_date) LEFT JOIN rrc3 ON (room.resort = rrc3.resort) AND (room.room_class = rrc3.room_class) AND (room.type_of_room = rrc3.type_of_room) AND (room.business_date = rrc3.business_date) LEFT JOIN rp ON (room.resort = rp.resort) AND (room.room_class = rp.room_class) AND (room.business_date = rp.business_date) GROUP BY room.property_id, room.business_date, room.room_class, room.type_of_room, room.organization_id, room.resort, room.total_room, ooo.ooo, oos.oos, cc.canceled_reservations_for_today, rrc2.reservations_cancellations_made_today, rrc1.reservations_made_today, rp.payment, rrc3.arrival_rooms_for_tomorrow, rrc3.arrival_persons_for_tomorrow

datamart_v2.v_manager_flash_detail.ddl: CREATE VIEW `3000550035.datamart_v2`.v_manager_flash_detail UUID '002e7479-2612-44bb-95ed-e0fc76af8632' (`id` String, `company_name` Nullable(String), `company_alias_name` Nullable(String), `agent_name` Nullable(String), `agent_alias_name` Nullable(String), `complimentary` UInt8, `business_date` Nullable(Date32), `resort` Nullable(String),
